m.s: Season {chk_thigh} with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes a side until golden and cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Rest on a board, then slice.
While the chicken cooks, bring a big pot of well-salted water to the boil.
Turn the heat under the chicken pan down to medium. Add crushed {garlic} and sliced {sundried} and stir for 1 minute, scraping up the golden bits.

Add {cream}, {stockpowder} dissolved in ¼ cup hot water, and {oregano}. Simmer for 3 minutes until slightly thickened. Stir in grated {parm} and {spinach} until the spinach wilts, then add the chicken back.
Cook {pasta} until al dente. Scoop out a mug of pasta water, then drain.
Toss the pasta through the sauce with a splash of the pasta water until it's glossy and coats every piece. Season to taste and serve.

l: A splash of pasta water or milk brings the sauce back when reheating. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF pasta in a separate pot. Check the stock powder.
